label.purpose: Navigation groups, metadata, and table headers.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The sparse, high-emphasis action used to advance work.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 38px; border: 1px solid var(--primary); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 8px 14px; color: #fffaf4; background: var(--primary); font: 680 14px/1.55 'Noto Sans SC Variable', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: var(--primary-dark); background: var(--primary-dark); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 38%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #761619; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A neutral supporting action that does not compete with the workflow primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 38px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 8px 14px; color: var(--ink-800); background: var(--surface); font: 680 14px/1.55 'Noto Sans SC Variable', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--ink-500); color: var(--ink-950); background: #f3f0ea; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 38%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A compact full-width field for operational data entry.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">商品名称<input value="虾滑" aria-label="商品名称"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink-800); font: 610 13px/1.55 'Noto Sans SC Variable', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-xs); padding: 9px 10px; color: var(--ink-950); background: #fffefa; font: 400 14px/1.55 'Noto Sans SC Variable', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms ease-out, box-shadow 160ms ease-out; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--primary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 14%, transparent); }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The solid active marker inside the deep-ink global navigation.
components.html: 工作台
components.css: .ds-nav { padding: 10px; background: var(--ink-950); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; min-height: 40px; align-items: center; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 9px 11px; color: #fff; background: var(--primary); font: 690 14px/1.55 'Noto Sans SC Variable', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--primary-dark); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 38%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ledger Card
components.description: A flat bordered container for dense operational content.
components.html:
商品工作区

从商品入口继续维护事实、SKU 与平台档案。
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 20px; color: var(--ink-800); background: var(--surface); font: 400 14px/1.55 'Noto Sans SC Variable', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0 0 4px; color: var(--ink-950); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 720; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-650); } .ds-card:focus-within { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 38%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Readiness Step
components.description: A compact evidence-aware step showing known, neutral, or locked workflow state.
components.css: .ds-readiness { display: flex; min-height: 90px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 16px 18px; color: var(--ink-950); background: var(--surface); font-family: 'Noto Sans SC Variable', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-step-number { display: inline-flex; width: 30px; height: 30px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--success); border-radius: 50%; color: #fff; background: var(--success); font-weight: 760; } .ds-readiness strong, .ds-readiness small { display: block; } .ds-readiness strong { font-size: 14px; } .ds-readiness small { margin-top: 4px; color: var(--ink-500); font-size: 11px; } .ds-readiness:focus-within { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 38%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The workbench feels like a disciplined operations ledger: deep ink navigation establishes a stable command frame, warm paper surfaces hold dense working information, and cinnabar marks the few actions that advance the workflow. The interface is intentionally professional, direct, and restrained; hierarchy comes from grouping, typography, dividers, and state language rather than decorative effects.

Evidence is part of the visual system. Current, pending, locked, warning, and unavailable states must be explicit in words and structure, never inferred from color alone. Dashboard shortcuts remain neutral whenever facts, SKUs, or platform profiles were not queried, and future capabilities carry their real phase label instead of fabricated progress.
keyCharacteristics: Desktop-first, information-dense Operate mode with a persistent command frame.
Warm paper and deep ink surfaces, with sparse cinnabar action emphasis.
Low-radius geometry, fine dividers, semantic tables, and no decorative gradients.
Honest state language, keyboard-visible focus, and resilient narrow-screen stacking.

rules.name: The Sparse Cinnabar Rule
rules.body: Reserve the primary color for active location, important action, and concise workflow emphasis; never wash whole dashboards in it.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Green means a state is actually known. Unknown or unread data uses neutral ink and explanatory copy, never green, amber, or an inferred progress state.

rules.name: The Operations Scale Rule
rules.body: Headings orient; they do not advertise. Keep titles compact enough that tables and next actions remain visible in the first viewport.

rules.name: The Ledger-First Rule
rules.body: Give the largest uninterrupted area to the user’s real records and next action; supporting scope and shortcuts stay secondary.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal adjacency to separate working regions. Do not add floating cards, ambient drop shadows, glass effects, or gradient depth.

rules.name: The Low-Radius Rule
rules.body: Rounded corners soften the ledger without making it playful; never turn primary work surfaces into pills.

dos: Do keep the most important product record, data reliability, and next action scannable within seconds.
Do use semantic landmarks, tables, controls, alert/status roles, accessible names, and visible keyboard focus.
Do label unavailable capability with its real phase and keep unread dashboard data neutral.
Do preserve every core action at narrow widths through stacking and horizontal overflow.
Do use Phosphor icons with a consistent stroke language.
donts: Don't fabricate metrics, completion percentages, regulatory feeds, or SKU/profile readiness that the current API did not return.
Don't use gradients, decorative shadows, glass surfaces, oversized marketing type, or stacked generic statistic cards.
Don't use color as the only status signal or let low-emphasis text fall below the approved ink-500 and warning contrast corrections.
Don't replace semantic controls with clickable containers, handwritten SVGs, emoji, or CSS illustrations.
